headline: Cut Loose
caption:
Giga Chikadze is off the UFC roster after four straight losses.
Fair or not? 👇

The two-time UFC main eventer (15-7) was among three featherweights cut, per the Roster Watch newsletter, along with William Gomis and Douglas Silva de Andrade. His skid started with a decision loss to Arnold Allen at UFC 304.

🔥 Hot take: Chikadze was a contender who never got back his spark.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Fair or not?
hot_take: A two-time main eventer, *gone* after four straight losses.
